Today's bench picked after XL: state gaps.counterscale == 1
Bench Classic XL: state gaps.readingscale == 14 (every reading 1.4 times), Today: 10
the Counter figures setting the XL theme saves is drawn: gaps.counterscale; gaps-counter-menu saves it by the menu
Enlarge every reading: state gaps.readingscale == 14
counter figures drawn at the saved scale: state gaps.counterscale
every reading drawn at the saved scale: state gaps.readingscale
key ctrl+= and ctrl+- step cfg.interfaceScale 100 > 125 > 150 > 125 > 100 and the window follows (look.scale); ctrl+0 back to auto
Bench Classic XL: the Workbench palette (look.bg) with gaps.counterscale == 2, gaps.readingscale == 14, gaps.nudges == 0
Glass Cockpit: state look.bg == #070b0f and look.accent == #7df3ff
Daylight Lab: state look.bg == #cfd5dc and look.accent == #1d4ed8
Field Radio: state look.bg == #23271a and look.accent == #d6bf5e
the Colour choice is saved (cfg.bandPlanPalette); what each palette paints is held by test_slint_host_bandpalette (the scratch profile has no band in view to read)
choose Size Large / Medium / Small: state gaps.ribbonsize == 3 / 2 / 1, the ribbon tier the window draws
choose Colour Vivid / Mono / Classic: state cfg.bandPlanPalette
the meter menu pick (a seam calls its callback: a popup's rows are not reachable by label): state gaps.meterstyles
style 0 (classic) picked for the sample rate meter: gaps.meterstyles == classic,...
style 1 (needle) picked: gaps.meterstyles == needle,peak
style 2 (led) picked: gaps.meterstyles == led,classic
style 3 (peak) picked for the volume meter: gaps.meterstyles == led,peak
each meter keeps its own style: SAMPLE RATE and VOLUME read back separately
expect Signal strength value contains dB while the generator runs
click the pointer ledger tick: state gaps.ledger == 1 and gaps.ledgerline contains os cursor / client origin; off again: line empty
click Copy diagnostics: state gaps.diagcopies == 1 and the status line (one function, diag_copy.cpp)
the SDRplay block (intro, key, status) is drawn: expect Run SDRplay diagnostic enabled
click Run SDRplay diagnostic: the dialog opens (expect Run the diagnostic)
a readout: the warning words are held by test_slint_host_sdrplaydiag
click Also test the bias tee: asks (expect Yes, switch it on); after a yes expect checked == true
the bias question appears on the tick and goes on Cancel (expect Yes, switch it on, then the tick back unchecked)
click Yes, switch it on: the box shows ticked and the stand-in child is started with the bias tee (state gaps.probebias == 1)
click Cancel on the question: the bias tee stays off (expect Also test the bias tee checked == false)
click Run the diagnostic: state gaps.probestarts counts the stand-in child, gaps.probereport reads its file
click Cancel on the dialog: state gaps.probestarts unchanged
the key runs the stand-in probe and its report is read; the real probe on an RSP is UNVERIFIED
a dropped list goes to the import (state gaps.drops, gaps.dropnote == list); the OS drag itself is UNVERIFIED
a dropped .xml is taken as a frequency list (state gaps.dropnote == list)
the same drop handler serves the TOOLS import (state gaps.dropnote == list)
click Browse...: the stand-in choice (FOXSDR_FILE_PICK) arrives in the box (expect Import path value contains frequencies.xml); the real file chooser is UNVERIFIED
the same Browse... key of the shared dialog
a readout: the waiting line's words are held by test_slint_host_signal (diskWaitLine)
a readout: the waiting line of the shared dialog
the moment a take is being closed is too short to catch from a script; the Saving label and the dead key are held by test_slint_host_signal
as row 1369, for the audio take
choose each of the three, read back as state deemphasis
click RESTART SDRPLAY SERVICE: the stand-in counts the call (UAC prompt UNVERIFIED)
a readout: the restart progress line
a readout: the restart outcome line
